newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodian PM Hun Sen postpones India trip.
newsitem.headline: Cambodian PM Hun Sen postpones India trip.

text.p: Cambodia's co-Premier Hun Sen has postponed a planned trip to India next week, citing the political crisis in New Delhi, a senior aide said on Friday.
"He cancelled it because the government of India has some crisis, so he doesn't want to disturb our friends there," said Prak Sokann.
India has sought a leader to replace Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda since the Congress Party withdrew support for his 15-party coalition government.

Hun Sen, who was to leave for India on April 24, is embroiled in a political crisis at home, where ties between his Cambodian People's Party and the royalist FUNCINPEC party have plunged to their lowest level since the former foes formed a coalition government after elections in 1993.
Prak Sokann acknowledged that the situation was "a bit tense."
